title: Attenuation of LPS-induced inflammatory responses in J774A.1 macrophages by phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes from Lavandula coronopifolia Poir.
task: Evaluate anti-inflammatory effects of Lavandula coronopifolia phytochemicals in LPS-stimulated macrophages
key_results: Compounds 2, 3, and 6 significantly reduced iNOS and IL-6 expression and cell migration; compound 5 showed selective cytotoxicity to A549 lung carcinoma (EC50 11.5 µM) without toxicity to HEK293T cells
comments: Natural product screening identified multiple bioactive compounds with complementary activities; selectivity of compound 5 for cancer cells is promising but mechanistic basis remains unclear.

model_io.model: LPS-stimulated J774A.1 macrophages and A549 lung carcinoma/HEK293T cell lines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes suppress LPS-induced inflammatory responses
hypotheses.result: Compounds 2, 3, and 6 downregulated iNOS and IL-6 expression and reduced macrophage migration similar to dexamethasone

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compound 5 exhibits selective antiproliferative activity against lung carcinoma
hypotheses.result: EC50 11.5 µM against A549 with no toxicity to normal HEK293T cells

title: VISFATIN: a novel modulator of placental endocrinology under physiological and pathological conditions—in vitro studies involving INSR, ERK1/2, and PKA signalling pathways
task: Characterize visfatin-mediated regulation of placental endocrine function via INSR/ERK1/2/PKA pathways
key_results: Visfatin bidirectionally modulated mRNA/protein expression of steroidogenic and protein hormones; hormone secretion was differentially regulated by INSR, ERK1/2, and PKA across normal and pathological placental tissues
comments: Pathway specificity varies by hormone and pregnancy condition, suggesting context-dependent signaling that may explain heterogeneous clinical manifestations in IUGR, PE, and GDM.

model_io.model: BeWo placental cells and villous explants from normal, IUGR, PE, and GDM pregnancies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visfatin regulates placental steroidogenic enzyme expression and hormone secretion
hypotheses.result: Visfatin bidirectionally modulated HSD3B1, CYP19A1, CGB3, CSH1, and GH2 expression in tissue-dependent manner

hypotheses.hypothesis: INSR, ERK1/2, and PKA mediate visfatin effects on hormone secretion
hypotheses.result: E2, hPL, and GH2 secretion required all three pathways; P4 secretion required only INSR and ERK1/2

title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation is associated with improved functional recovery and time-dependent changes in apoptosis-related execution-phase markers after spinal cord injury
task: Determine rTMS effects on apoptosis pathway activation and motor recovery after spinal cord injury
key_results: rTMS reduced caspase-3/caspase-7/PARP1 activation in a time-dependent manner at later time points; improved tissue preservation and functional motor recovery (BBB scores)
comments: Time-dependent effects suggest mechanistic complexity; limited early-stage efficacy warrants optimization of rTMS timing protocols.

model_io.model: Rat spinal cord injury (Allen's method) with rTMS treatment initiated day 2 post-injury

hypotheses.hypothesis: rTMS attenuates execution-phase apoptosis signaling after SCI
hypotheses.result: Time-dependent reduction in caspase-3/7/PARP1 cleavage at later time points with enhanced tissue preservation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apoptotic signaling is localized to neurons
hypotheses.result: Double immunofluorescence confirmed NeuN and cleaved caspase-3 co-localization in neurons

title: Engineered Ti₃C₂ MXene nanosystems for macrophage-targeted therapy of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis
task: Macrophage-targeted ROS scavenging and anti-inflammatory therapy for MASH
key_results: MMCT reduced intracellular ROS, enhanced SOD activity, and shifted M1 macrophages to M2 phenotype; treatment mitigated lobular inflammation and macrovesicular steatosis in murine MASH model
comments: Novel nanoplatform design cleverly exploits mannose receptor targeting, though in vivo efficacy requires further validation in clinically relevant models.

model_io.model: Murine MASH model with hepatic macrophages

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mannose receptor-mediated endocytosis enables selective macrophage targeting
hypotheses.result: MMCT successfully localized to hepatic lesions with amplified antioxidant efficacy

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROS scavenging and TLR4/NF-κB inhibition promote macrophage repolarization
hypotheses.result: M1-to-M2 phenotypic shift with downregulation of pro-inflammatory mediators and suppressed lipid droplet accumulation

title: A metaheuristic automated framework for quality improvement of CT imagery
task: Automated CT image quality enhancement via optimized clip-limit selection
key_results: WOA-PIQE-CLAHE framework achieved PIQE of 29.81±1.14 (vs 32.02±0.99 baseline) and contrast of 71.54±1.04 (vs 69.31±1.05 baseline) on 315 CT slices
comments: Straightforward metaheuristic optimization for image preprocessing; clinical validation of downstream diagnostic improvement not demonstrated.

model_io.model: WOA-PIQE-CLAHE (Whale Optimization Algorithm + Perception Image Quality Evaluator + Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization)
outputs: enhanced CT slices with optimized clip-limit parameter

hypotheses.hypothesis: Automated whale-algorithm optimization of CLAHE clip-limit improves perceptual quality and contrast without noise amplification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: lower PIQE and higher contrast achieved compared to low-contrast baseline

title: Machine learning-based prediction of 3-month mortality in elderly patients with non-small cell lung cancer and bone metastases
task: Develop machine learning model for 3-month mortality prediction in elderly NSCLC patients with bone metastases
key_results: Logistic regression achieved AUC 0.79 on validation set (n=531) with accuracy 0.78±0.02 across 10-fold CV; 3-month mortality rate 48.5% in cohort of 1,773 patients aged ≥70
comments: Interpretable logistic regression outperformed more complex ML algorithms; internal validation only—external validation critical before clinical deployment.

model_io.model: Seven ML algorithms (logistic regression, ensemble methods, neural networks)
inputs: SEER database clinical features: demographics, cancer characteristics, treatment details, comorbidities for 1,773 elderly NSCLC patients with bone metastases
outputs: 3-month cancer-specific mortality prediction (probability), model performance metrics (AUC, calibration, decision curves)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex ML models outperform logistic regression for mortality prediction
hypotheses.result: Refuted: logistic regression demonstrated superior and most stable performance (highest AUC and average accuracy)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Absence of chemotherapy, presence of liver/brain metastases, and short diagnosis-to-treatment time are key mortality predictors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: identified as top influential predictors in logistic regression model

title: Serum proteomic signatures and an immune-calcium signaling cascade associated with antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction in schizophrenia
task: Identify molecular mechanisms underlying antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction in schizophrenia
key_results: 473 differentially expressed serum proteins between APRED and non-APRED groups; 10 hub proteins identified with RYR3 as central regulatory node linking calcium and immune signaling
comments: Solid proteomics-driven biomarker discovery but mechanistic validation (e.g., functional studies) is absent; causality cannot be inferred from association.

model_io.model: Label-free quantitative serum proteomics with PPI network analysis
inputs: serum samples from 66 male schizophrenia patients on risperidone (APRED vs non-APRED stratified by nocturnal penile tumescence)
outputs: differentially expressed proteins, PPI network, hub protein identification

hypotheses.hypothesis: APRED involves immune-calcium signaling disruption and extracellular matrix remodeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: functional enrichment showed significant enrichment in immune/inflammatory responses, calcium signaling, and ECM organization pathways

hypotheses.hypothesis: RYR3 is a central regulatory hub connecting calcium and immune pathways in APRED
hypotheses.result: Supported: RYR3 emerged as top hub protein in PPI network analysis

title: Prediction of groundwater level in shallow and complex aquifers using hybrid soft computing models and metaheuristic algorithms
task: Groundwater level prediction in shallow aquifers using hybrid ANN-metaheuristic models
key_results: ANN-POA reduces RMSE by 29.3% and MAE by 24.1% vs. standalone ANN; test RMSE 0.213–0.287 m, MAE 0.260–0.437 m across three wells
comments: Hybrid ANN-POA and ANN-HBO with MRMR feature selection is thorough; 1-month lagged groundwater and precipitation identified as dominant predictors; framework is practical for water-scarce regions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metaheuristic optimization (POA/HBO) improves ANN generalization in data-scarce non-stationary aquifer systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ANN-POA reduces RMSE 29.3%, MAE 24.1% vs. baseline ANN

title: FL-trafficNet: a hybrid federated transformer-GNN framework with dual attention for smart routing in IoV and VANET environments
task: Hybrid federated Transformer-GNN routing for IoV and VANET
key_results: MAE=1.95, RMSE=2.87, MAPE=3.12; privacy score 97.8%; traffic delivery rate 38.4%, outperforming recent methods
comments: Transformer + GNN + federated learning + RL for routing is comprehensive; dual-attention mechanism for spatial-temporal features is well-motivated but privacy metric definition is unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federated learning + Transformer-GNN dual attention improves routing accuracy and privacy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; low prediction errors (MAE 1.95), high privacy score (97.8%), improved TDR (38.4%)

title: Federated multi-cloud task scheduling with load balancing using multi-objective NSGA-II and reinforcement learning
task: Multi-objective task scheduling in federated multi-cloud environments
key_results: Reduces makespan by 18–32%, improves resource utilization by 10–22%, achieves better load balance vs. baselines
comments: Hybrid NSGA-II + Q-learning integration is reasonable but the improvement margins are incremental; federated settings remain underexplored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of NSGA-II with Q-learning enables adaptive federated scheduling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via simulation on Google Cloud traces and IoT workloads

title: Geometry-aware localization evaluation of grad-CAM for wafer map defect classification
task: Evaluating Grad-CAM localization accuracy on wafer defect classification
key_results: Baseline Top-10% IoU = 0.129; radial suppression improves by 19.4% to 0.155 (p≪0.001); oracle upper bound 0.278
comments: Thorough bias analysis and geometric correction are valuable; the radial bias likely reflects CNN architectural properties rather than a Grad-CAM artifact.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radial attribution bias is intrinsic to model representations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both Grad-CAM and XGrad-CAM exhibit structurally similar bias

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radial suppression reduces localization error
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; avg Top-10% IoU improves from 0.129 to 0.155

title: Task-oriented visual SLAM: a comprehensive map classification framework for dynamic indoor robot manipulation
task: Task-oriented visual SLAM map classification for mobile manipulation
key_results: Proposes taxonomy of four map categories (geometric 3D, semantic, object-level, hybrid) with systematic comparative analysis across adaptability, pose accuracy, and computational feasibility
comments: Comprehensive survey paper identifying key limitations and future directions; lacks new experimental validation or quantitative benchmarks on the proposed taxonomy.

title: Exact wave structures in magneto-optic soliton channels governed by Kudryashov-type coupled Schrödinger dynamics
task: Soliton propagation in magneto-optic waveguides under Kudryashov-type nonlinearity
key_results: Derives new spectrum of exact analytical solutions (kink, antikink, singular profiles) with parametric characterization; enables precise control over pulse stability and transition gradients
comments: Theoretical framework using improved simple equation method; provides analytical foundations for optical switching but experimental validation is absent.

outputs: exact soliton solutions (kink, antikink, singular profiles)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tuning nonlinear coefficients enables precise control of soliton pulse stability and gradients
hypotheses.result: Confirmed analytically; parametric characterization demonstrates controllable transitions

title: Optimized routing with Ant Colony Algorithms to extend network lifetime in Wireless Sensor Networks
task: Energy-efficient routing in wireless sensor networks
key_results: Saves energy by 18–25%, improves packet delivery rate by 6–10%, extends network lifetime
comments: Ant colony optimization with residual energy and spatial awareness is well-motivated; gains are solid but modest.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two energy metrics and spatial awareness improve routing over single-metric ACA
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in NS-2 simulations across variable node densities

title: Robust and intelligent control strategies for a 3-DOF robotic arm: a comparative study
task: Comparative control strategies for trajectory tracking of 3-DOF robotic manipulator
key_results: SMC achieves ~80% RMSE reduction vs. PID, ~50% for FLC; SMC maintains peak Cartesian errors <0.005 m vs. PID ~0.11 m; validated against published dynamics
comments: Rigorous comparison of PID, FLC, and SMC with complete Euler-Lagrange dynamics including friction and coupling; SMC's superiority is clear but limited to 3-DOF planar case.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sliding Mode Control outperforms PID and FLC for nonlinear 3-DOF manipulator tracking
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SMC achieves 80% RMSE reduction, <0.005 m Cartesian error vs. baselines

title: Robust graph-transformer soft sensor for radar level estimation in dynamic LPG storage systems
task: Radar level estimation in LPG storage using graph-transformer soft sensor
key_results: RGTN achieves R²=0.9704, MAE=151.12 mm, RMSE=198.33 mm, outperforming existing models under dynamic marine conditions
comments: Graph attention + Transformer fusion for spatiotemporal dependency is well-designed; soft-sensor approach avoids expensive hardware upgrades.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph attention + Transformer spatiotemporal fusion improves level estimation under dynamic conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; R²=0.9704, outperforms baselines on real LPG carrier data

title: A hierarchical neuromorphic multi agent framework for energy aware and secure 6G resource optimization using Neuro6G agent
task: Neuromorphic hierarchical multi-agent framework for energy-aware 6G resource optimization
key_results: 34.7% energy reduction, 28.3% latency decrease, 95.6% threat detection accuracy vs. baselines (p<0.01); validated on DeepMIMO, DVS128, CICIDS-2017
comments: Spiking neural networks + multi-agent RL is ambitious; significant gains are demonstrated but the three benchmark datasets are heterogeneous and not representative of integrated 6G scenarios.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Neuromorphic agents with distributed trust reduce energy and latency in 6G systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 34.7% energy reduction, 28.3% latency decrease across benchmarks

title: WHiAR-Net: an interpretable multi-scale forecasting framework via Wavelet-Hilbert feature engineering
task: Interpretable multi-scale time-series forecasting via wavelet-Hilbert feature engineering
key_results: WHiAR-Net achieves competitive accuracy outperforming modern deep learning baselines on electricity and environmental datasets
comments: Wavelet + Hilbert spectral analysis with embedded operator error bounds is principled; transparency is valuable but specific quantitative results are absent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wavelet-Hilbert decomposition separates long-term trends from transient fluctuations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via competitive forecasting performance on benchmark datasets

title: Improved Pied Kingfisher Optimization Algorithm for optimal scheduling of microgrids with hybrid energy storage
task: Optimal scheduling of microgrids with hybrid energy storage
key_results: IPKO achieves 4–10% lower mean daily operating cost with significantly reduced solution dispersion vs. representative metaheuristics
comments: Four complementary enhancement strategies (Chebyshev chaos, multi-source guidance, differential-spiral, dynamic adjustment) are comprehensive; gains are consistent but incremental.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enhanced IPKO strategies improve convergence and solution quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 4–10% cost reduction and lower dispersion across independent runs

title: A federated blockchain framework for secure and intelligent smart farming in sustainable industrial agriculture
task: Federated blockchain for privacy-preserving smart farming
key_results: Accuracy 92.4%, throughput 2350 TPS, block latency 1.0 s; privacy leakage reduced 73%, energy cost reduced 45%
comments: Reasonable integration of FL and hybrid PBFT-PoA consensus; practical deployment metrics are impressive but comparison baselines are underspecified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid PBFT-PoA consensus is more scalable and energy-efficient than standard PoW
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2350 TPS, 1.0 s latency, 45% energy cost reduction vs. baselines

title: A flow field reconstruction based on cylindrical wake flow data using the PSO-CNN-LSTM algorithm
task: Spatiotemporal reconstruction of cylindrical wake flow using PSO-CNN-LSTM
key_results: Streamwise velocity error ~10⁻³, cross-stream error ~10⁻², outperforms LSTM/RNN/Transformer in ten-step rolling prediction
comments: Principled architecture combining CNN, LSTM, and PSO hyperparameter tuning; uncertainty quantification via Monte Carlo dropout is well-motivated and validates error-uncertainty coupling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PSO-CNN-LSTM outperforms baseline RNN/Transformer in vortex shedding reconstruction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; lower errors and improved stability in rolling prediction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-stream velocity is more challenging due to phase dependence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cross-stream error (~10⁻²) larger than streamwise (~10⁻³)

title: Biologically inspired optimization of construction sector eco industrial park networks using food web metrics
task: Bio-inspired optimization of construction eco-industrial park networks using food web metrics
key_results: Genetic algorithm optimization demonstrates scenario- and objective-dependent structural proximity to biological food-web benchmarks; connectance acts as key structuring constraint; reciprocal participation rules yield more balanced solutions
comments: Comprehensive biomimetic framework integrating symbiosis and food-web principles; results show clear trade-offs across metrics rather than uniform improvement, highlighting feasibility constraints in construction sectors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimization toward biological food-web structural patterns improves construction EIP sustainability
hypotheses.result: Partial confirmation; scenario rules and OFT choice yield distinct morphologies with systematic trade-offs

title: Flashover prediction of polluted composite insulators based on arc time constant and velocity using CNN–LSTM
task: Flashover prediction of polluted composite insulators using CNN-LSTM
key_results: Superior performance to benchmarked approaches; unified arc model bridges analytical models and real flashover dynamics
comments: Physics-informed architecture coupling arc time constant and velocity is well-motivated; CNN-LSTM captures transient arc propagation better than static models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic coupling of arc time constant with arc velocity improves flashover prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CNN-LSTM achieves superior performance with fail-safe predictions

title: Enabling geometry and toolpath generalization for machine learning based thermal modeling in laser powder bed fusion
task: Geometry and toolpath generalization for thermal modeling in laser powder bed fusion
key_results: ~1000× speedup vs. finite element analysis while maintaining high accuracy; generalizes to new geometries and toolpaths
comments: Elegant feature engineering using signed distance fields and time-gradient fields enables cross-geometry generalization without retraining; practical impact on manufacturing is significant.

model_io.model: U-Net CNN with signed distance fields

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intelligent feature engineering enables generalization across part geometries and toolpath orientations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; single model generalizes without geometry-specific retraining

title: Wideband monopole MIMO antenna with pattern diversity and wide beamwidth coverage in elevation plane for C-band applications
task: Design wideband MIMO antenna with high isolation and pattern diversity for C-band
key_results: 4–8 GHz bandwidth (10-dB), isolation >23.3 dB, ECC <0.0017, gain 6.5–9.4 dBi, HPBW >132°
comments: Merging higher-order monopole resonances via feeding-position optimization is practical, though the mechanism underlying ultra-low ECC achievement warrants discussion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotationally symmetric placement and shorting stubs achieve high isolation without disrupting resonances
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; isolation >23.3 dB and ECC <0.0017 across passband

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tilted omnidirectional patterns with broad HPBW provide pattern diversity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; four patterns each with HPBW >132°

title: Diameter-dependent nanojoint formation and grain refinement in femtosecond laser nanojoining of AgNWs
task: Understand diameter-dependent nanojoint formation in femtosecond-laser-welded silver nanowires
key_results: 60 nm diameter AgNWs achieve 544% relative joint cross-sectional area vs. 73% (200 nm) and 19% (300 nm); nanojoint interface grain size refined to 4.42 nm vs. 15.69–26.27 nm in non-bonded regions
comments: The inverse correlation between nanowire diameter and joining efficiency is elegantly explained by localized electromagnetic field enhancement, though the mechanism of grain refinement deserves deeper investigation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Smaller nanowire diameter leads to stronger localized electromagnetic field enhancement and better nanojoint formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 60 nm diameter shows highest joint cross-sectional area and finest grains

hypotheses.hypothesis: Higher electric field intensity correlates with polycrystalline grain refinement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; regions with enhanced field intensity exhibit 4.42 nm average grain size

title: Uniaxial structural flexibility of an anisotropic Br adlayer structure on Au(100) electrodes revealed by video-rate STM
task: Characterize lateral structural flexibility and vacancy diffusion in dense Br adlayer on Au(100)
key_results: Pseudo-hexagonal c(√2×2√2)R45°-Br adlayer exhibits uniaxial dynamic distortions via antiphase shifting along [010]; DFT confirms low diffusion barriers for fractional vacancies
comments: Video-rate STM elegantly reveals dynamics inaccessible to static techniques, and DFT validation strengthens the one-dimensional vacancy diffusion mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural anisotropy of the Br adlayer permits uniaxial distortions via one-dimensional fractional vacancy diffusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; STM observations and DFT barriers are consistent

hypotheses.hypothesis: Low diffusion barriers enable rapid dynamic adaptation of the adlayer to embedded surface species
hypotheses.result: Supported by DFT predictions and STM-observed high-frequency lateral deformations
